summary: Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US analogue of an 8-K) attaching its restated Bylaws as Exhibit 99.1. The document is a routine corporate-governance filing: it recites authorized capital of up to 13,176,900,000 shares, subscribed and paid-in capital of R$136,909,898,070 represented by 11,026,869,192 book-entry shares (5,617,742,977 common; 5,409,126,215 preferred), and preferred-share privileges including a R$0.022 minimum non-cumulative annual dividend and 80% tag-along rights. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date is disclosed; no special-situation event is present.
